A revolutionary republic is a form of government whose main tenets are popular sovereignty , rule of law , and representative democracy . It is based in part on the ideas of Enlightenment thinkers, and was favored by revolutionaries during the Age of Revolution . A revolutionary republic tends to arise from the formation of a provisional government after the overthrow of an existing state and political regime. It often takes the form of a revolutionary state, which ostensibly represents the will of its constituents. [ 1 ]
